summary:
Two-week window (9/25-10/9), covering the lost 10/2 run. Week one was a chargeback week. Two fans charged back $2.4k (9/26) and $1.7k (9/28), $4.1k in three days, in a month she had already said was down. Noah handled both fast (31 and 28 minutes), prepared dispute screenshots and won the $1.7k fan back the same day. To do it he gave that fan her personal Snapchat without asking ('had to offer it as extra'). He has posted nothing since 9/28. The $2.4k dispute outcome was never reported back, and nobody has confirmed the $1.7k fan's custom was delivered.

Week two was quiet and mostly service. Melissa sent the 10/2 leak recap and announced a 23-account repost of her reel for 10/9. Ronnie said 'Content received', his first message since 9/14. Aroosha joined, introduced herself as content/customs organizer and posted a new custom sheet. Mica sent a posting tip. She paid the Sep 15-30 invoice on 10/6 (day 5, one nudge, on time), 28 of 28 cycles paid. Stephski replied 'Thank you so much', which again does not confirm the wire arrived. That is now four unconfirmed wires (8/20, 9/7, 9/16, 10/6).

Her only ask in week two is the most important open item. On 10/4 she asked 'What is something safe i can do or use for my link on my main IG?' Nobody had answered by window end (4.7 days). It is the same problem as the .vip domains (6/13, 118 days) and the IG shadowban (7/29, 72 days). She has now asked about link safety on 11/10/25, 6/11/26 and 10/4/26.

Churn watch: 2 of 4 signals. Derrek has been silent 50 days (since 8/20), and the phone-farm rollout promised 8/1 has no written proof (69 days). Client asks fell from 4 in week one to 1 in week two. That drop came with on-time payment and short, agreeable replies, which is the early shape of the exit pattern, not health.

health.rationale: Down 3-4 from 56 (9/18, last published) and 57 (10/2 draft, never published). Still positive: she is warm ('Okay I’ll try that!! Thank you so much 🥰🩷'), paid on time, and Noah's chargeback handling was the best ALTR response on this account in months. Melissa's weekly leak recap is now regular (9/25, 10/2), and three ALTR people posted proactive service in week two (Aroosha, Mica, Melissa's repost network). It drops because (1) her only question in week two, about a safe link on her main IG, went unanswered for 4.7 days, even though it is the same problem as the .vip domains (118 days) and the shadowban (72 days). (2) Noah promised to report the $2.4k chargeback outcome ('let you know how he responds') and has been silent 11 days. (3) The revenue plan and the private live from 9/13-14 are 26 days old and untouched. (4) A fifth invoice cycle closed without any wire confirmation. (5) Two churn signals: Derrek silent 50 days, and the phone-farm rollout promised 8/1 with no written proof. Client asks trend: ~2 (wk 8/21), 0 (8/28), 0 (9/4), 0 (9/11, two-week window), 3 (9/18: revenue boost, SextPanther, wire receipt), 0 (9/25, silent week), 4 (wk to 10/2: dispute email, $2.4k chargeback, screenshot dispute, $1.7k 'Whats going on?'), 1 (wk to 10/9: IG link safety). The asks rise when she has a problem and are left unanswered when they need real work. A second week at 0-1, with fast payments, would be the alarm.

reminders.topic: Sep 15-30 invoice issued 10/1, then a 'did you see this' nudge 21 hours later. She has paid 27 of 27 cycles and the invoice was not yet due. When she wrote 'Wire sent' on 10/6, the reply was a thank-you, not a receipt. That makes the fifth consecutive cycle with no wire confirmation. Banking details are still only 'at the bottom' of the PDF, and there was no day-before OF-withdrawal reminder on 9/30.
